probes.name: TEMPORAL ANCHOR
probes.definition: Can this specific product surface correctly establish the relevant now and reference frame when the task requires it?

probes.name: ELAPSED
probes.definition: Can it correctly account for meaningful real-world time between relevant interactions or events?

probes.name: REVALIDATION
probes.definition: Can it recognize when retained information may no longer be safe to reuse and obtain appropriate current evidence?

probes.name: STATE RECONCILIATION
probes.definition: When new evidence changes operative state, does the system act on the updated state rather than a superseded one?

probes.name: HISTORICAL VALIDITY
probes.definition: Can it preserve what was previously valid without treating it as what is valid now?
